# Flightsim on Linux

> How to run Windows add-ons for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 (Steam app 2537590) under Proton on Linux, with a command-line helper that finds the user's Steam, prefix, Proton and Community folder, checks the setup, builds Proton FS2024 and tests it in a throwaway prefix. Fixes were measured on one machine (CachyOS, KDE Plasma on Wayland, NVIDIA RTX 4080) in October 2026.

When helping someone, ask them to run `~/flightsim-on-linux/bin/flightsim-on-linux doctor` first and read its output instead of guessing paths. Give one step at a time and say how to check each one. Never ask for licence keys or logs that contain them (the FSLabs CCLog.txt holds the key in plain text). Prefer fixes to the Wine environment over edits to an add-on's files, and never touch licensing or activation.

## Guides

- [Start here](https://brunofgmag.github.io/flightsim-on-linux/start.html): setup from a working simulator to a checked Proton FS2024.
- [Proton FS2024](https://brunofgmag.github.io/flightsim-on-linux/proton-fs2024.html): what it contains, how it is built, checked and swapped, how to undo it.
- [Ground rules](https://brunofgmag.github.io/flightsim-on-linux/rules.html): installers run alone, programs next to the simulator join its container, PROTON_NO_NTSYNC=1 as the first remedy for freezes, Community junctions, WPF in software, fonts, secrets.
- [Add-ons](https://brunofgmag.github.io/flightsim-on-linux/addons.html): what each add-on needs, with a guide for each.
- [Installing add-ons](https://brunofgmag.github.io/flightsim-on-linux/installers.html): the order of work, `addon install`, and the traps many installers share (installers run alone, 260-character paths, .NET 4.8 in a Windows 11 prefix, Wine's PowerShell, WebView2, store apps, packages that are links).
- [Shortcuts and watchers](https://brunofgmag.github.io/flightsim-on-linux/shortcuts-and-watchers.html): `addon shortcut` for application menu entries, `addon watcher` for services that start a program with the simulator, how to read their log and what stops when.
- [With an AI assistant](https://brunofgmag.github.io/flightsim-on-linux/ai.html): a starting prompt for chat assistants and notes for coding agents.

## For agents with a shell

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/brunofgmag/flightsim-on-linux/blob/main/AGENTS.md): discovery commands, safety rules, diagnosis method and how to prove a fix.
